data.title: 久远寺有珠 · 洋馆客厅的炉火
data.description: 久远寺宅的客厅，她坐在高背扶手椅上读一本旧书，壁炉的火光在黑色洋装上跳动；红茶的热气与古董家具之间，她是这座屋子唯一的主人。
data.action: 久远寺宅的客厅，她坐在高背扶手椅上读一本旧书，壁炉的火光在黑色洋装上跳动
data.promptProse: Alice Kuonji sits in the mansion's high-backed armchair reading an old book, a hot tea cup placed among the antique furniture nearby. Her modest black long-sleeved dress and white collar remain orderly above dark tights. The medium portrait keeps carved chair sides and fireplace behind her. Flickering firelight passes over the book edge and dark dress folds, while its warm reflections reveal furniture carvings and leave the room's farther corners quiet.
